confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Central area chief. Radio at 09:30 says scoop 2 (LH-02) is stopped at C564-08. CMMS OT-5001 shows it closed 20 min ago and operational. Confirm whether LH-02 is running. Move nothing for C564-08 until then.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at C590-09, a high-grade stope at 16.5 g/t. Radio and CMMS agree (OT-5100, hydraulic, 3-5 h, repaired on site), so this is a real stoppage. LH-10 is in the shop for preventive maintenance and is free from 10:00 (06:00 start plus 4 h). Using it costs no other place any production, because it is not taking over from another working loader. Travel from TALLER-564 to C590-09 is about 0.33 h, so it starts around 10:20. At 80 m from the stockpile an LH410 mucks about 31 t/h. Over the remaining ~6.3 h that is about 195 t, which is below the 256 t still broken in the stope (361 t minus 105 t mucked). At 16.5 g/t that is up to about 103 oz. Central haulage is close to truck-limited: 4 trucks give roughly 90 t/h, and the stockpile is at 303 of 450 t. Much of that ore would therefore displace lower-grade ore. I discounted the gain to about 40 oz. It is higher if LH-02 is really down. LH-02 has a radio/CMMS conflict, so under CONFIRM-01 I am not moving anything for that place. No loader is taken from a producing place or a development heading, and there are no stopped stopes whose loaders could activate a reserve, so I activated none.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
